author: Myworld6
body:
Name: DaGoldBrick
Reason: Racism and rudeness on the forums. 
Evidence: Unfortunately, I can't access these anymore due to them being archived. However, if you check his archived posts you should see what I mean.
Anything else to add? Brick hasn't even been warned for his actions. Moreover, considering that racism on the server can result in either a kick or a temp ban, I believe that a similar punishment should be meted out in this case, due to him ignoring the fact that his post was archived and proceeding to post a similar message two more times.

Thank you for your time, good luck and apologies if it looks like I'm telling you how to do your job.

Love,
Myworld.

replies.author: TooSweetSki
replies.body:
I did say in Slack that I believe I did the right thing by archiving his questionable replies.
I also noted that I would warn and then temp ban him if his behaviour continues.

I am keeping an eye on him, considering he hasn't done anything as of late, hopefully nothing else comes up.
If it does, I will deal with it.

replies.body: With all due respect, a warning should have been meted out after the first offence, not after he had carried out the action three times. I'm not faulting your considerable ability as a mod, merely the fact that he has been allowed to behave the way he has without further opposition.
